title: RNWY record: a dated public record of MCP servers and ERC-8004 agents
description:
The dated public record kept by RNWY (https://rnwy.com). One file per day says what each listed MCP server answered when it was checked. On the 1st of each month a snapshot of the month just ended is added: one row per listed MCP server; one row per indexed on-chain agent, with the date its score was computed; the month's tool-list history; the registration-file record of ERC-8004 agents on Ethereum, BNB Chain and Base (fingerprints and dates, not the files); and RNWY's review analysis, with the method it was made under.

Every file's SHA-256 is in a manifest, and each file is signed when it is committed. The record says what was observed and when. Scores and the review analysis are RNWY's readings under its published methodology (https://rnwy.com/methodology); they are not findings of fact about any server, agent, owner or reviewer.
